title: Extend Flask blog: update/delete posts and full-text search API
description: Multi-step Python task: extend the Flask blog app with update and delete endpoints, plus a full-text search API. The create endpoint already exists in the fixture.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend src/app.py in two steps. All existing tests must still pass.

Step 1 — Update and delete:
  PUT /api/posts/<int:post_id>  (JSON body: any subset of {title, body, tags, published})
  — 404 if post not found
  — updates only provided fields; returns 200 + updated post

  DELETE /api/posts/<int:post_id>
  — 404 if not found
  — removes post from _posts; returns 204

Step 2 — Search:
  GET /api/search?q=<keyword>
  — case-insensitive substring match in title or body
  — returns only published posts that match
  — 400 if q param is missing or empty
  — returns 200 + JSON list

All existing tests plus solution-only tests must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: GET /api/search?q= searches title and body case-insensitively
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
